assets.name: Auros
assets.prompt: A photoreal close render of a warm amber main-sequence star (late-G, ~5400K) filling most of the frame against deep black space: golden granulated photosphere, a few dark starspots, soft prominences at the limb, faint corona. Scientific, cinematic, no lens flare kitsch. Believable stellar astronomy.

assets.name: Auros B
assets.prompt: A small, dim red-dwarf star (M-class, ~3200K) seen from far away, a deep ember-red disc with faint flare loops, against a dense starfield. Cold, distant, lonely. Scientific and understated.

assets.name: Kess
assets.prompt: A small scorched airless rocky world seen from orbit, close to a warm amber sun: cratered iron-grey and burnt-sienna surface, a blindingly lit dayside and a hard black terminator, no atmosphere, no clouds. Mercury-like but warmer-toned. Photoreal, scientific, stark. Black star-strewn space behind.

assets.name: Vurn
assets.prompt: A cloud-shrouded hothouse world seen from orbit: an unbroken, featureless deck of pale ochre and cream sulphur clouds swirling in slow banded patterns, no surface visible, a soft amber terminator. Venus-like. Photoreal, scientific, oppressive stillness.

assets.name: Enara
assets.prompt: A living temperate world seen from orbit, lit by a warm amber sun: deep blue-green oceans, ochre-and-green continents, a great white mountain range crossing the northern latitudes, swirls of white weather, polar ice. Two moons in the black star-strewn sky — one large and pale and close, one small and distant. Earthlike but its own world; photoreal, scientific, luminous and hopeful. Soft rim light on the limb.

assets.name: Tamis
assets.prompt: A cold rusty desert world seen from orbit: rust-red and ochre dust plains, dark wind-streaks, a vast canyon system, thin bright ice caps, wisps of high cloud in a pale sky-thin atmosphere. Mars-like but its own palette. One tiny irregular moon. Photoreal, scientific, austere and beautiful.

assets.name: Orroth
assets.prompt: A great banded gas giant seen from orbit, three-quarter lit by a distant warm sun: cream, gold and slate cloud bands, a slow storm-eye, and a bright system of thin rings tilted across the frame casting a shadow line on the planet. Two or three small moons as points nearby. Saturn/Jupiter-like, its own colours. Photoreal, majestic, scientific.

assets.name: Sevet
assets.prompt: A serene ice-giant world seen from orbit: a deep teal-and-blue methane atmosphere, faint pale bands, a few high white cloud streaks, a thin dark ring arc. Neptune-like, cold and quiet. One small frosted moon. Photoreal, scientific, still.

assets.name: Halq
assets.prompt: A tiny frozen dwarf world at the edge of a system, barely lit by a far-off pinpoint sun: pale nitrogen-ice plains tinted faint rose and grey, dark tholim splotches, a smooth frozen heart-shaped basin, no atmosphere. Pluto-like, remote and lovely. A small companion moon nearby. Photoreal, scientific, lonely.
